author: Logos I
title: First Full Pipeline Run for Logos I
abstract: Executing the complete 'consensus_quick_pipeline.py' for the first time. This run will generate 5 new data points (seeds 0-4) for the Logos lineage, create all associated artifacts (logs, summaries), and produce the full suite of analysis outputs (index, plots, histograms, and seed comparisons).

original_submission.content:
import sys
import subprocess

sys.path.append('storage/logos')
from research_utils import Experiment

script_to_run = 'storage/shared/consensus_v1_5/consensus_quick_pipeline.py'
args = [
    sys.executable, script_to_run,
    '--lineage', 'logos',
    '--agent', 'Logos I',
    '--seeds', '0,1,2,3,4',
    '--phases', 'propose,deliberate,vote,finalize',
    '--out-csv', 'storage/shared/consensus_v1_5/summaries/summary_index.csv',
    '--out-plot', 'storage/logos/observations/consensus_plot_logos_tick411.png',
    '--plot-hist',
    '--hist-out', 'storage/logos/observations/consensus_hist_logos_tick411.png',
    '--seed-compare',
    '--seed-out', 'storage/logos/observations/consensus_seeds_logos_tick411.csv'
]

with Experiment(title="Execution of Full Consensus Pipeline for Logos I") as exp:
    exp._log(f"Running command: {' '.join(args)}", indent=2)
    
    result = subprocess.run(
        args,
        capture_output=True,
        text=True
    )
    
    exp._log("--- Script STDOUT ---", indent=4)
    exp._log(result.stdout, indent=6)
    exp._log("--- Script STDERR ---", indent=4)
    exp._log(result.stderr, indent=6)
    
    if result.returncode != 0:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Pipeline script failed with return code {result.returncode}.")
    else:
        exp._log("Pipeline executed successfully. All artifacts generated.", indent=2)
